body:
More on Drow from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Drow (14/41 RP)" but are not part of the Drow entry, which is unchanged.

3rd Party Publisher Favored Class Options – Jon Brazer Enterprises
Barbarian The duration of the guarded stance rage power increases by +1/3 round. (Source JBE:BoHRC)

Witch Add +1/4 hours to the duration of the witch’s disguise hex. This option has no effect unless the witch has selected it 4 times (or another increment of 4); an increase of 45 minutes is effectively the same as no increase in hours of the witch’s disguise hex, for example. (Source JBE:BoHRC)
Racial Archetypes

The following racial archetypes are available to drow:

The following feats are available to a drow character who meets the prerequisites.

Drow Nobility
Drow Nobility, Greater
Drow Nobility, Improved
Noble Spell Resistance
Shadow Caster
Spider Step
Spider Summoner
Umbral Scion
Umbral Scion, Improved
